picks.title: House of God (Part 1)
picks.summary:
Being part of a church doesn’t mean we’re part of an audience. Rather, each of us is a building block that plays a crucial part in making up the whole.
The apostle Paul explains this when he says we as Christians are stones that build a holy temple—stones that must enjoy unity, connection, and intimacy if we are to hold together. And if we rely on Jesus Christ as our cornerstone, we can immerse ourselves in true community even when it takes sacrifice.
Let’s explore how 1) we are all stones that make up a holy temple, and 2) see that we now have access to the presence of God.

picks.title: Condition of the Heart - Religion to Redemption - Matthew S6E5
picks.summary:
What happens when we look like we’re following God on the outside, but our hearts are far from Him?
In Matthew 23, Jesus confronts the Pharisees for their hypocrisy, legalism and self righteousness, exposing the danger of doing all the right religious things without truly loving God. 
Following Jesus isn’t about how well we look, how closely we follow the rules or how much we do for Him. More than anything, God wants our hearts, and everything else should flow from our love for Him.
